scope: Local evidence-intake replication, two authored tasks, three paired repetitions; not an autonomous coding-agent benchmark
limitations: A narrow 10.20% observed aggregate on two authored tasks; not a general or per-task 10% guarantee.
Three paired repetitions; one repetition was below 10%; no strong statistical generality claimed.
All retry-replication provider calls succeeded first attempt; live cloud recovery was not exercised.
Transient retry behavior is separately covered by deterministic faults and a real loopback HTTP 503-to-200 integration test.
Whole task timings include fresh preprocessing, decision requests, reader execution and quality checks; exclude common frozen-corpus construction and queue wait.
No primary model changes; no selection reuse, rescore, deleted failure, release or marketplace publication.
Fixed subscription bill reduction and quota effects were not measured.
